name: 1D Min-Max Mipmap Construction
definition: A data structure built on each row of the rectified shadow map to accelerate finding lit segments of a ray by storing min/max values of the shadow heightfield.
summary: 1D Min-Max Mipmap Construction builds a flat hierarchical structure from rectified shadow map rows to accelerate volume rendering by skipping occluded regions using iterative min-max bounds instead of recursion.
